SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.
Section S, Special Branch Section,
REPORT
Date January 13, 1936.
Subject Miss Anna Ginsbourg, Secretary of the International League of
Cultural Co-operation (in China).
Made by D.J. MAKAROFF    Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the attached report of D.J.I. Kao Yen-
ken on the subject of the International League of Cultural
Co-operation, I have to state that the secretary of the
organization, one Miss Anna Alexandrovna Ginsbourg, is a
Soviet citizen, of Jewish origin, born on June 20, 1911 at
Samara.
Prior to her arrival here she resided in Harbin together
with her parents and studied in one of the local schools
there. Upon completion of her studies she entered the
Oriental University, Juridicial faculty, and finally graduated
as a lawyer in 1933.
In September 1933, Anna Ginsbourg came to Shanghai and
attempted to become a member of the Russian Juridicial
Society. However, she was not accepted when the committee
found out that she was a Soviet citizen. Soon afterwards,
she established a juridicial consulting office at flat 2,
House 150, Route des Soeurs, where she is still practising
as a lawyer. Her father, Alexander B. Ginsbourg, also a
Soviet citizen, is an old attorney-at-law and formerly an
advocate attached to the Saratov District Chamber of Justice.
He is also practising in Shanghai and is registered with the
2nd and 3rd Branches of the High Court of Kiangsu Province.
Miss Anna Ginsbourg has a good knowledge of the English
language and is believed to have contributed various articles
to the China Weekly Review, a periodical edited by J.B.Powell.
She is registered with the Bureau of Public Safety,
Nantao, as a Soviet citizen.
[签名]
D. S.
D. C. (Sp. Br.)

报告

事由：安娜·金斯堡小姐（Miss Anna Ginsbourg），国际文化合作联盟（在华）秘书。
制作人：D.J. MAKAROFF    转呈人：[签名]

关于附件中 D.J.I. Kao Yen-ken 就国际文化合作联盟一事提交的报告，本人须陈述如下：该组织秘书安娜·亚历山德罗芙娜·金斯堡小姐（Anna Alexandrovna Ginsbourg）系苏联公民，犹太裔，1911年6月20日出生于萨马拉。

在抵达此地之前，她与父母同住哈尔滨，并在当地一所学校就读。学业完成后，她进入东方大学法律系学习，最终于1933年以律师身份毕业。

1933年9月，安娜·金斯堡来到上海，并试图成为俄罗斯法律学会的会员。然而，当委员会发现她是苏联公民后，未予接纳。不久之后，她在姐妹路（Route des Soeurs）150号2室设立了一家法律咨询事务所，目前仍在该处以律师身份执业。其父亚历山大·B·金斯堡（Alexander B. Ginsbourg）亦为苏联公民，是一位资深律师，曾任萨拉托夫地区司法厅附属辩护律师。他也在上海执业，并已在江苏省高等法院第二和第三分院注册。

安娜·金斯堡小姐精通英语，据信曾向由 J.B. Powell 编辑的期刊《密勒氏评论报》（China Weekly Review）投稿多篇文章。

她已在南市公共安全局登记为苏联公民。
[签名]
D. S.
D. C. （特务科）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.
S.1, Special Branch XXXXX,
REPORT
Date November 15, 1935.

Subject    The International League of Cultural Co-operation (in China)
           - new organization formed.

Made by    D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken    Forwarded by

A new organization called the "International
League of Cultural Co-operation (in China)" was formally
inaugurated between 4 p.m. and 7.30 p.m. on November 10
in the residence of Wei Ding-yun (魏鼎云), 999 Route de
Zikawei. About fifty foreigners and Chinese including
A. Avshalomoff, Librarian of the S.M.C. Public Library,
were present.

The promoters of this body are :
Y.S. Tsao (曹有祥), aged 42, a returned student from
England and U.S.A., and living at 1273 Rue Lafayette.
He is employed in the Compradore's Office of the Yee
Tsoong Tobacco Company, and is concurrently Chief of the
Economic Research Office of the Central Bank of China,
15 The Bund, Secretary-General of the China Institute
of Scientific Management, 43 Hardoon Road and Secretary
of the China Red Cross Society, 856 Sinza Road.
Hsu Long-shi (徐朗西), Headmaster of the Sing Hwa (新華)
Art College, T'an Pu Jao, Nantao.
Sung Kai-chi (沈開基), a teacher of the Ellis Kadoorie
Public School for Chinese, 445 Shanhaikwan Road.

The aims of the League are :
1. To create a favourable environment for a closer
understanding between China and other nations through
cultural co-operation.
2. To search for the best in foreign and Chinese civilizations
for mutual enlightenment.
3. To rejuvenate the Chinese nation with those elements of
the modern western civilization which are lacking in the
old Chinese culture.

一个名为“国际文化合作联盟（中国）”的新组织于11月10日下午4时至7时30分之间，在霞飞路999号魏鼎云 (Wei Ding-yun) 的寓所内正式成立。约有五十名外侨和华人出席，其中包括工部局公共图书馆馆长 A. Avshalomoff。

该组织的发起人为：
曹有祥 (Y.S. Tsao)，42岁，英美留学生，现住拉斐德路1273号。他就职于颐中烟草公司买办间，并兼任中国银行经济研究处处长（地址：外滩15号）、中国科学管理学会秘书长（地址：哈同路43号）以及中国红十字会秘书（地址：新闸路856号）。
徐朗西 (Hsu Long-shi)，新华艺术专科学校校长，校址位于南市谭步桥。
沈开基 (Sung Kai-chi)，山海关路445号埃利斯·嘉道理华人公立学校教师。

该联盟的宗旨为：
1. 通过文化合作，营造有利于增进中国与其他国家相互了解的环境。
2. 探寻外国与中国文明中的精华，以资互相启迪。
3. 以中国传统文化中所缺乏的现代西方文明要素，来振兴中华民族。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Monday, November 11, 1935

Cultural Group
Organized Here

Dr. Y. S. Tsao President
Of International
Organization

The International League of Cultural Co-operation in China was formally inaugurated yesterday with Dr. Y. S. Tsao as president and Miss Anna Ginsburg as secretary.
The inauguration took place at the home of Mr. Wei Ding yun, 999 Ziccawei Road, where tea was served, followed by discussion of the Chinese drama and an example of it with Miss Pai Yu-shwang in the leading role. Foreigners and Chinese present also enjoyed strolls through Mr. Wei's beautiful rock garden.

Aims Of Organization
The aims of the I.L.C.C. are: to create a favorable environment for a closer connection and understanding between China and other nations through cultural co-operation; to search for the best in international and Chinese civilizations for mutual enlightenment to rejuvenate the Chinese nation with those elements of the modern Western civilization which are lacking in the old Chinese culture; and to promote the development of a new Chinese culture not only for its own benefit, but for its contribution to the cultural progress of the world.
The field to be covered by the League includes philosophy, the fine arts, music, drama, literature, history, law and social sciences, medicine, and the natural sciences.

Lecture On Chinese Drama
A lecture on the Chinese drama by Mr. Yao Hsin-nung, a well known Chinese writer, featured the inaugural meeting. Mr. Yao pointed out that Chinese civilization was largely out-of date and much of it was of no value to the Young China that he represents. The Chinese drama was an excellent example of old Chinese cultural inadequacy in the modern world.
He urged that the Chinese drama be adapted to presentation of current life, retaining its best qualities—such as its exquisite movements—and sloughing off what is archaic. He said the attempt at revision of dramatic forms had so far been largely left to "illiterate barbarians" who knew nothing of art and sought to pack the theatres by stooping to cheap showmanship. One had recently billed a live alligator as the chief attraction in a play, while an actor had resorted to a curious trick of biting off the head of a turtle in his performance to express something or other,—just what was not clear.

Lively Discussion
Mr. Yao's lecture provoked a lively discussion, the most striking part of which was that the only 10 per cent defense of the old Chinese drama came from a foreigner, who said that such a stage symbolism as brandishing a whip to convey the impression of riding a horse was more vivid and effective than the actual riding of a horse could be. All the Chinese who spoke on the subject were critical of the Chinese drama, although all of them did not agree entirely with Mr. Yao.
The play presented by Miss Pai was a short farce entitled "The Little Maid Blowing Her Own Horn." It was an example of the "ping-ping," popular Peiping drama. Miss Pai is a well known Chinese actress who was expelled from Peiping sometime ago by ex-Mayor Yuan Liang for allegedly immoral exhibitions. She is now very popular in Shanghai.

中国国际文化合作联盟于昨日正式成立，由曹云祥（Y. S. Tsao）博士担任主席，安娜·金斯伯格（Anna Ginsburg）小姐担任秘书。
成立仪式在魏定云先生位于霞飞路999号的寓所举行，会上供应茶点，随后就中国戏剧问题展开讨论，并由白玉霜小姐主演了一出剧目作为示例。在场的外国人和中国人还兴致勃勃地参观了魏先生美丽的假山花园。

该组织之宗旨
国际文化合作联盟（I.L.C.C.）的宗旨是：通过文化合作，为增进中国与其他国家之间的紧密联系与理解创造有利环境；探寻国际文明与中国文明中的精华以相互启迪，用古老中国文化中所缺乏的现代西方文明要素来振兴中华民族；并推动新中国文化的发展，这不仅有利于其自身，亦有助于世界文化的进步。
该联盟涉及的领域包括哲学、美术、音乐、戏剧、文学、历史、法律与社会科学、医学以及自然科学。

关于中国戏剧的演讲
中国著名作家姚莘农先生在成立大会上发表了关于中国戏剧的演讲。姚先生指出，中国文明在很大程度上已过时，其中大部分内容对他所代表的“青年中国”毫无价值。中国戏剧正是旧中国文化在现代世界中 inadequacy（不足/缺陷）的一个绝佳例证。
他敦促对中国戏剧进行改编，以表现当代生活，保留其最优良的品质——如优美的身段动作——并摒弃那些陈旧过时的部分。他说，迄今为止，改革戏剧形式的尝试 largely（主要）留给了“不学无术的粗人”，这些人不懂艺术，却试图通过屈尊采用廉价的噱头来吸引观众填满剧院。最近有人在一出戏的宣传中将活鳄鱼列为主要看点，而一名演员则在表演中 resort to（采取）了一种咬掉乌龟头的奇特伎俩，以表达某种含义——究竟是何含义，并不清楚。

热烈的讨论
姚先生的演讲引发了热烈的讨论，其中最引人注目的是，对旧式中国戏剧的唯一一成辩护来自一位外国人，他说，诸如挥舞马鞭以传达骑马印象这样的舞台象征手法，比实际骑马更为生动有效。所有就此议题发言的中国人都对中国戏剧持批评态度，尽管他们并非完全同意姚先生的观点。
白玉霜小姐演出的剧目是一出名为《小丫鬟自吹自擂》的短滑稽剧。这是流行的北平戏剧“评评”（音译）的一个例子。白小姐是中国著名女演员，不久前因被指控进行不道德表演而被前市长袁良驱逐出北平。她目前在上海非常受欢迎。
